verdict.rationale: Bolna documents its own automation: API-driven multi-step workflows that combine calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, plus per-agent webhooks that push data to a CRM after every call. Neither is documented as a general user-defined rule engine where events trigger chosen actions, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit event-trigger/condition rule definitions, documentation of which events can trigger actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Build multi-step outreach sequences that combine voice agent calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, driven entirely through the Bolna API.
Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI. Push data to your CRM from every call.
